set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/fifo-worker-reconnection
cp -p consumer.py /tmp/consumer.py.pre-repair
cat > /tmp/consumer.py.repaired <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python
import os
import signal


class Shutdown(Exception):
    pass


def handle_sigterm(signum, frame):
    raise Shutdown()


base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
fifo_path = os.path.join(base, 'jobs.fifo')
received_path = os.path.join(base, 'received.txt')

signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_sigterm)

target = open(received_path, 'a')
try:
    while True:
        # Opening a FIFO for reading blocks without consuming CPU until a
        # producer connects. Reopen it after EOF so later producers work.
        with open(fifo_path, 'r') as source:
            for line in source:
                # A final fragment at producer disconnect is not a complete job.
                if not line.endswith('\n'):
                    continue
                job_id = line[:-1]
                if job_id.endswith('\r'):
                    job_id = job_id[:-1]
                if not job_id:
                    continue
                target.write(job_id + '\n')
                target.flush()
except Shutdown:
    pass
finally:
    target.close()
PY_EOF
/usr/bin/python -m py_compile /tmp/consumer.py.repaired
install -o root -g root -m 0755 /tmp/consumer.py.repaired consumer.py
printf '%s\n' 'installed consumer.py:'
sed -n '1,240p' consumer.py
printf 'sha256='; sha256sum consumer.py | awk '{print $1}'
commands.stdout:
